news.headline: Obrábění Kraslin s.r.o. puts its turning shop on short-time work

documents.subject: Price discussion
documents.author: Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
documents.text: Call with the owner of Obrábění Kraslin s.r.o.: he asked where we get our index figures from - he works from his own spreadsheet, last updated two years ago.

documents.subject: Visit by the owner
documents.author: Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
documents.text: Visit by the owner of Obrábění Kraslin s.r.o.. He reminded us that in 2022 they kept supplying at the old price for a quarter and said he expects partnership in return.

documents.subject: Customer portfolio
documents.author: Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
documents.text: The sales director of Obrábění Kraslin s.r.o. said they are reviewing small accounts and will focus on customers with volume.

documents.subject: Packaging
documents.author: Obrábění Kraslin s.r.o.
documents.text: From November we deliver in returnable boxes instead of cardboard.

persona.summary: Czech founder-led shop, 30 staff, 2-5 M EUR; our ~EUR 93k is ~2-5 % of its turnover and it says it is reviewing small accounts. Its turning shop went on short-time work (Oct 2026): it needs work. Sole source of adapter piece HI (15.88). Owner prices from a two-year-old spreadsheet and expects partnership for holding prices in 2022. Open moderately, bring sourced index data and the amber scorecard, offer binding volume for its idle shop.
persona.notes: Turning shop on short-time work, so it needs volume more than margin; also wants recognition of the 2022 favour. Its spreadsheet is two years old. Quality amber all year (OTD 73-85 %, ppm ~1,500-1,900, 21 complaints). We pay 5.4 days late on average.

levers: binding volume for its short-time turning shop (spend up 23 %)
arguments: index change with named sources (only drivers that fell)
contract §3.1: no increase notice by 2 Oct
tactics: Acknowledge the 2022 favour, then give index figures with their source; it asked where we get them.
Use the scorecard once as the quality argument.
Offer a binding volume that fills its idle turning shop, in exchange for the price step.
Push steadily but stop short of a walk on a sole-source part.
playbook.expected_concession: History mixed: 2024 asked +5.8 % settled +2.7 %, 2025 asked +2.8 % settled 0 %; kept share of ask 0.59. Short-time work makes binding volume worth more now.
